mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the protein threads to the platelet plug was most worthwhile because it showed how the two parts work together to stop bleeding.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the initial cut was the least interesting step: the rough edge and skin made the result predictable, though it set up the repair.

surprise.text: The skin stayed open even after bleeding stopped. That helped me distinguish a clot from a healed cut.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and labels made the pairings understandable, although I followed the enzyme label rather than knowing how the threads form.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the open skin heals, though the choices here were fairly straightforward.
